Ministry of Education

Smart India Hackathon 2024 Concludes with Innovative Solutions

Celebrating student innovation across nation

प्रविष्टि तिथि: 16 DEC 2024 7:40PM by PIB Mumbai

Pune, 16 December 2024

The Ministry of Education's Innovation Cell and AICTE successfully concluded the Smart India Hackathon 2024 (SIH) at MIT Art, Design, and Technology University, Pune, marking a grand celebration of innovation and problem-solving prowess.

In a highly competitive environment, Team Jagarama007 (Coal Ministry), VoltAces, and Mavericks emerged as top winners, impressing with their groundbreaking solutions.

Other joint winners included The Olympians, Paradox Innovator, Rail Manics, and Nidaan 7.0, who addressed real-world challenges posed by various ministries.
